summary: Russian forces launched extensive drone and missile strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions including Odesa, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava, Mykolaiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, and Donetsk, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. Ukrainian forces conducted strikes on Russian border regions including Belgorod, Kursk, Bryansk, and Leningrad Oblast. Russian troops liberated Artelovo in Kharkiv direction and Blahodatne in Zaporizhzhia region, while fighting continues in Kupyansk, Dobropillia, and Kherson sectors.
key_points: Russian forces launched X-59 missile toward Tuzly in Odesa region and Su-34 fighter-bomber toward Crimea with Kh-59 missile threat. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69336)

Multiple Shahed drone groups detected: 3 from Chernihiv to Kyiv region Vyshhorod district, 7 toward Reni/Orlivka, and groups over Chernihiv, Mykolaiv, Kharkiv, Sumy, Dnipropetrovsk, Poltava regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69328)

Russian troops liberated Artelovo village in Kupyansk district using 34th Guards Motor Rifle Brigade and 11th Tank Battalion, while Ukrainian reserves increase in western Kupyansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Ukrainian strikes hit Russian border regions: Belgorod (apartment building, civilians injured), Kursk (civilians injured), Bryansk (man killed, woman wounded), Leningrad Oblast (50 UAVs downed). (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Zelensky stated Ukraine wants to resume talks with Russia by autumn after call with US envoys Kushner and Witkoff, warned of difficult winter and Russian blockade of grain corridor. (Source: @UkraineNow/82855)
Ukraine introduced new voluntary mobilization mechanism allowing direct interaction with military units, bypassing TCC, with 5-day protection from forced mobilization. (Source: @UkraineNow/82861)

Russian strikes killed 3 and injured 10+ in Pavlohrad (Dnipropetrovsk), injured 14 in Slovyansk (Donetsk) damaging 7 high-rises, hit fuel facility in Zhytomyr, and injured 3 civilians in Kherson region. (Source: @UkraineNow/82849)
EU imposed largest sanctions package in 4 years (218 items); Ireland allocated €125M (€100M non-lethal equipment, €25M infrastructure protection). (Source: @UkraineNow/82867)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted widespread drone and missile attacks across at least nine Ukrainian regions overnight, including Kh-59 missile threats to Odesa and Crimea, while Ukrainian strikes hit Russian border regions causing casualties. Russian troops liberated Artelovo in Kharkiv direction and Blahodatne in Zaporizhzhia, with ongoing combat in Kupyansk, Dobropillia, and Kherson sectors. Zelensky announced Ukraine seeks talks with Russia by autumn amid grain corridor blockade and winter preparation warnings.

points: Ukrainian air defense detected and tracked multiple Russian attack vectors: X-59 missile toward Tuzly (Odesa), Su-34 toward Crimea with Kh-59 threat, Shahed drone groups from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod), 7 Shaheds toward Reni/Orlivka, UAVs over Chernihiv (Mena, Kholmiv), Mykolaiv (Arbuzynka, Bashtanka to Voznesensk), Kharkiv (city area, Merefa, Birky), Sumy (Sumy, Krolevets, Shostka), Dnipropetrovsk (Bozhedarivka), Poltava (Kobeliaky, Kremenchuk, Hlobyne), and Odesa (Tatarbunary). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69336, @mon1tor_ua/69328, @mon1tor_ua/69334, @eRadarrua/102340, @kpszsu/69851, @kpszsu/69876, @eRadarrua/102310, @kpszsu/69863, @eRadarrua/102351, @kpszsu/69877, @kpszsu/69854, @kpszsu/69860)

Civilian casualties from Russian strikes: 3 killed and at least 10 injured in Pavlohrad (Dnipropetrovsk) with food industry enterprise damaged and fire; 14 injured in Slovyansk (Donetsk) from aerial bombs on residential buildings damaging 7 high-rises; fuel facility hit in Zhytomyr causing fire but no casualties; 3 civilians injured in Kherson region (Aleshki, Velikie Kopani, Golaya Pristan) with infrastructure damage in 8 settlements. (Source: @UkraineNow/82849, @UkraineNow/82865, @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Ukraine implemented new voluntary mobilization order: candidates interact directly with chosen military units without TCC/SP involvement; commanders can issue VLK referrals; volunteers protected from forced mobilization for minimum 5 days after referral. (Source: @UkraineNow/82861)

Zelensky stated Ukraine wants to resume negotiations with Russia by autumn after phone call with US special envoys Kushner and Witkoff; expects three-way meeting; warned Russia blocks grain corridor by attacking ships/ports; said Ukraine should prepare for difficult winter. (Source: @UkraineNow/82855, @ukr_leaks_eng/31867)

Personnel developments: Drapaty appointed commander-in-chief of Ukrainian Armed Forces; Fedorov declined deputy PM for technological development, seeks defense minister post to implement army modernization; Syrsky and Hnatov to work with new leadership; Khmary and Drapaty tasked with air defense, TCC reform, mobilization issues. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31863, @ukr_leaks_eng/31846, @UkraineNow/82855)
MP Goncharenko stated less than half of TCC employees are combat veterans, many received IDs during ATO period. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31859)

Former FM Kuleba warned of "all-out war beginning" and food shortages due to Russian strikes, predicting both sides have enough missiles/drones to methodically destroy each other's economies. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31856)

Russian forces launched coordinated overnight strikes: Kh-59 missile toward Tuzly (Odesa), Su-34 fighter-bomber toward Crimea with Kh-59 launch threat, multiple Shahed drone groups from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv (Vyshhorod), Reni/Orlivka, and across northern/central/southern Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69336, @mon1tor_ua/69333, @mon1tor_ua/69328, @mon1tor_ua/69334)

Russian ground forces liberated Artelovo village in Kupyansk district (Kharkiv region) using 34th Guards Separate Motor Rifle Brigade (Mountain) and 11th Tank Battalion of 18th Mechanized Division, 11th Army Corps of "North" Territorial Defense Force; Ukrainian reserves increasing in western Kupyansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Russian troops liberated Blahodatnoye settlement in Zaporizhzhia region by 36th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade of 29th Army of "East" Territorial Defense Force; fighting continues in Shevchenko and Belitskoye (Dobropillia direction) with enemy counterattack capability. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Ukrainian strikes hit Russian border regions: Belgorod (apartment building attacked, civilians injured in Novaya Derevnya, Krasnaya Yaruga, Shebekino); Kursk (civilians injured in Tolpino, Belaya); Bryansk (man killed in Kartushino, woman wounded in Bely Berezhka, man injured in Suzemka); Leningrad Oblast (50 UAVs downed per governor). (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848, @tass_agency/386786)

In Sumy direction, Russian "North" Territorial Defense Force units engaged in firefights in Ulanovo, near Malaya Sloboda, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Mogritsa, Maryino, Novaya Sech, Khoten, forests south of Ivolzhanskoye; repelled 21st Separate Mechanized Brigade assault near Mogritsa; thwarted advances near Kondratovka, Pisarevka, Novaya Sech; fighting near Prokhody in Krasnopolsky district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Kherson region: three civilians injured in past 24 hours (Aleshki, Velikie Kopani, Golaya Pristan); infrastructure/property damage in Velikaya Blagoveschenka, Vinogradovo, Demyanovka, Nizhnyye Serogozy, Podovo, Rayskoye, Khornakh, Yubileynoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Russian oil/gas revenues in July may rise 60% year-on-year due to higher oil prices per Reuters; oil/gas sales constitute ~1/5 of Russian budget revenue financing war. (Source: @UkraineNow/82866)
Dobropillia direction: fighting in Shevchenko and Belitskoye with enemy capable of counterattacks. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Zaporizhzhia region: 36th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade of 29th Army liberated Blahodatnoye settlement. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Russian strikes hit Slovyansk (Donetsk) with aerial bombs on residential buildings: 14 injured, 7 high-rises damaged. (Source: @UkraineNow/82865)
Pavlohrad (Dnipropetrovsk) struck: 3 killed, at least 10 injured, food industry enterprise damaged with fire. (Source: @UkraineNow/82849)

Kharkiv direction: Russian forces liberated Artelovo village in Kupyansk district using 34th Guards Motor Rifle Brigade and 11th Tank Battalion; Ukrainian reserves increasing in western Kupyansk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Sumy direction: Russian "North" Territorial Defense Force engaged in firefights across multiple settlements (Ulanovo, Malaya Sloboda, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Mogritsa, Maryino, Novaya Sech, Khoten, Ivolzhanskoye forests); repelled 21st Mechanized Brigade assault near Mogritsa; thwarted advances near Kondratovka, Pisarevka, Novaya Sech; fighting near Prokhody in Krasnopolsky district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Ukrainian UAV activity detected over Belgorod, Kursk, Bryansk, Leningrad Oblast causing casualties and damage. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848, @tass_agency/386786)

Chernihiv region: Russian Shahed drone launches detected - 2 rockets on Mena, 1 from Kholmiv toward Kyiv region; UAV group in northern Chernihiv toward Slavutych. (Source: @eRadarrua/102340, @kpszsu/69849)
Kyiv region: 3 Shahed drones from Chernihiv toward Vyshhorod district detected. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69328)
Sumy region: Ukrainian UAVs detected heading toward Sumy, Krolevets, Shostka. (Source: @kpszsu/69863)
Russian "North" Territorial Defense Force active in Sumy direction with firefights in multiple settlements and forests south of Ivolzhanskoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Leningrad Oblast: 50 UAVs downed per governor, indicating Ukrainian drone activity toward St. Petersburg region. (Source: @tass_agency/386786)

Bryansk region: Ukrainian drone strike killed man in Kartushino (Starodubsky district), Grad MLRS fire wounded woman in Bely Berezhka (Trubchevsky district), FPV drone injured man in Suzemka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Kursk region: Ukrainian drone strikes injured woman in Tolpino (Korenevsky district) and young man in Belaya (Belovsky district). (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)

Odesa region: Russian X-59 missile toward Tuzly; Shahed drones toward Reni/Orlivka (7); reactive UAV in southern Odesa toward Tatarbunary; guided aviation missile on Tatarbunary; strikes on Odesa and Chornomorsk ports, naval vessels, drone warehouses, Nova Poshta logistics center causing power outages. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69336, @mon1tor_ua/69334, @kpszsu/69854, @kpszsu/69860, @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Mykolaiv region: Russian rocket on Arbuzynka; group of reactive UAVs through Bashtanka toward Voznesensk. (Source: @eRadarrua/102340, @kpszsu/69851)

Kherson region: Three civilians injured in past 24 hours (Aleshki, Velikie Kopani, Golaya Pristan); infrastructure/property damage in 8 settlements including Velikaya Blagoveschenka, Vinogradovo, Demyanovka, Nizhnyye Serogozy, Podovo, Rayskoye, Khornakh, Yubileynoye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Zaporizhzhia region: Russian 36th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade liberated Blahodatnoye settlement. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Crimea/Sevastopol: Repelled Ukrainian UAV attack overnight with high drone activity near Feodosia per Russian sources. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848)
Russian Su-34 fighter-bomber detected toward Crimea with Kh-59 missile launch threat. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69333)

Russian missile threats: X-59 toward Tuzly (Odesa), Kh-59 potential launch from Su-34 toward Crimea. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69336, @mon1tor_ua/69333)

(Source: @mon1tor_ua/69328, @mon1tor_ua/69334, @eRadarrua/102340, @kpszsu/69851, @kpszsu/69876, @eRadarrua/102310, @kpszsu/69863, @eRadarrua/102351, @kpszsu/69877, @kpszsu/69854, @kpszsu/69860)

Ukrainian UAV strikes on Russian territory: Belgorod (apartment building, multiple civilian injuries), Kursk (civilian injuries), Bryansk (1 killed, 2 injured), Leningrad Oblast (50 downed), Ulyanovsk region (energy facility). (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31848, @tass_agency/386786)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain offensive momentum across multiple axes, combining ground advances in Kharkiv and Zaporizhzhia with massive drone/missile barrages targeting energy, port, and civilian infrastructure across Ukraine. The liberation of Artelovo and Blahodatnoye suggests continued pressure on Kupyansk and Zaporizhzhia fronts. Ukrainian deep strikes into Russian territory (Belgorod, Kursk, Bryansk, Leningrad, Ulyanovsk) demonstrate growing long-range capability but risk escalation. The new mobilization mechanism may intensify as both sides prepare for winter, with Russia's rising oil revenues sustaining war funding and Ukraine's grain corridor blockade threatening food security.
sections.regional_response: EU implemented largest sanctions package in four years (218 items) targeting Russian economy. Ireland committed €125M in military and infrastructure aid. US lawmakers delegation planned for autumn/winter visit to Russia per Anna Paulina Luna, though sanctions bill passage uncertain. US special envoys Kushner and Witkoff engaged in shuttle diplomacy with Zelensky proposing three-way meeting by autumn. Russia's grain corridor blockade draws international concern but limited concrete response.
sections.intelligence_notes: Drapaty's appointment as commander-in-chief and Fedorov's push for defense minister post signal potential doctrinal shifts in Ukrainian military leadership. TCC reform remains contentious with less than half staff being combat veterans per Goncharenko. Russian "North" and "East" Territorial Defense Force designations suggest continued reliance on regional formations. The 50 UAVs downed over Leningrad Oblast indicates Ukrainian drone range extending to strategic depths. Kuleba's "all-out war" warning and Stupak's prediction of retaliatory strikes on Ukrainian businesses suggest economic warfare escalation.
